sources.entry: VeraCrypt - Disk encryption with strong security based on TrueCrypt.

summary.one_liner: VeraCrypt is a disk encryption tool, based on TrueCrypt 7.1a with security enhancements, whose README covers building its source code on Windows, Linux, macOS, FreeBSD and OpenBSD.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is the VeraCrypt source code archive, described as based on TrueCrypt 7.1a with security enhancements and modifications. The README is mainly build documentation: it lists requirements and steps for compiling on Windows (signing and MSI packaging via a sign.bat script and WiX Toolset v3.11), on Linux and macOS (GNU Make, wxWidgets 3.0, FUSE, PCSC-lite, with optional NOGUI console-only builds), and on FreeBSD 14+ and OpenBSD 7.8+. It also covers an EFI boot loader under src\Boot\EFI, an Arch Linux makepkg package build, and reproducible .deb and .rpm builds. Contributor guidance asks people to contact the maintainers before implementing features. The README does not describe end-user features in detail.
use_cases: build VeraCrypt from source on Linux
compile VeraCrypt for Windows with code signing
how_to_run: Console-only Linux build: make NOGUI=1 WXSTATIC=1
Windows: set WSDK81 environment variable, then run Signing/sign.bat
notable: Based on the TrueCrypt 7.1a codebase with security enhancements
Supports Windows, Linux, macOS, FreeBSD and OpenBSD builds
Optional console-only Linux build without a GUI library
Reproducible build guidance for .deb and .rpm packages
Windows driver and binaries are digitally signed by the project's certificate
caveats: FreeBSD requires version 14 or later, and OpenBSD requires version 7.8 or later
Console-only builds are not supported on macOS
Windows signing assumes a GlobalSign-issued code signing certificate and requires editing sign.bat for other CAs
macOS builds need Code Signing IDs edited in src/Main/Main.make or commented out; the SDK 10.9 is not recommended with macFUSE
